summary: clap-validator (pinned release binary) and Steinberg VST3 SDK validator (source build) can drive the real fixture cdylibs through Discover/Instantiate/Process/State without touching production adapter crates, and a fail-closed opt-in runner can record honest Passed/Failed/NotRun/Unsupported verdicts with artifact+tool digests
Provision clap-validator 0.4.1 windows release binary; clone VST3 SDK (commit 3cdf9ca5d1f5b1b21e0a86832aa4abe55607bd96) and build validator target with CMake+MSVC
First CLAP run: param module path '/' rejected; fractional sample rates rejected; event bound too small; instrument note processing failed; test_stateful failed 3 state-reproducibility cases
First VST3 run: mass 'Failed to setup test!' — terminate was terminal, setupProcessing accepted too narrow a state set, bus info mismatched spec
All violations are fixture-side contract breaches; fix inside test crates only, production adapters stay zero-diff. TDD: failing tests added before each fix

test_stateful root cause: state.load mutated param values without clap_host_params.rescan(CLAP_PARAM_RESCAN_VALUES) — required by CLAP when values change outside param events. PluginStateImpl now holds host handle and requests rescan on load
clap-validator panicked (exit 0xc0000409, 'a scoped thread panicked') on param-fuzz-sample-accurate — confirmed tool-side bug in validator sandbox, not a plugin defect

test_fault canonical run excludes param-(set|fuzz) declaratively (fatal fault modes arm via param mutation — intentional crash surface); unfiltered run kept as informational leg recorded as Unsupported evidence
VST3 SDK validator: 235 passed, 0 failed, exit 0. clap-validator: all 5 plugins canonical legs Passed, 0 failed. Runner verdict Passed, exit 0; evidence in evidence/rf630/abi-validator/
node --test ci/plugin-abi-validator/tests/: 18 pass, exit 0 — fail-closed NotRun/Unsupported/Failed verdicts pinned by contract tests
